evidence.note: isToday and isOverdue are computed only when a due instant exists and completed is false, so either flag implies hasDueDate and !completed.
hasDueDate duplicates dueDate presence and hasProject duplicates project presence.
hasMetadata is the OR of hasDueDate, hasLabels, hasProject, and hasSubtasks (plus a non-none priority), so any of those flags implies hasMetadata.

notes: Correction of todo-item-due-tone and r3-foundation-todo-item-presence: one TodoItem owner. priority is an enum, not a boolean. isSelected and hasDescription stay as independent axes. isToday and isOverdue may both hold for an earlier time on the current UTC day.

evidence.note: showLoading is isLoading AND action.type !== modal, so showLoading implies isLoading. isExecuted is an independent Option projection. type and executed are not boolean members; disabled is a JSX expression.

notes: Member correction: drop type, executed, and disabled from the boolean cluster.

disqualifier.note: indicator is a line|dot|dashed literal, not a boolean. hideIndicator and nestLabel are independent: the content parent derives nestLabel from item count and indicator shape and forwards hideIndicator unchanged, and the prop types admit every pair.
Same pair as ChartTooltipIndicator, passed through. indicator is not a boolean member, and neither flag excludes the other.
Same forwarded pair. No writer forces hideIndicator and nestLabel to be exclusive.
